instruction: Apply a batch adjustment to set the saturation of all three desktop images to 75 at once.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP does not support batch operations on multiple images at once through the GUI. Similar to the original task (batch brightness adjustment), batch saturation adjustment requires scripting or plugin functionality that is not accessible in the standard OSWorld environment.
